description: Validate addresses. Validate and standardize US addresses using USPS address data. Returns USPS-standardized versions of each submitted address along with a validation status indicating whether the address is deliverable. Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

data.description: Array of address objects to validate (max 1000).

city.description: City name. Required when not using full_address.

full_address.description: Complete address string (e.g., "1200 Barton Springs Rd, Austin, TX 78704"). Use this OR the structured fields below — not both.

state.description: Two-letter state abbreviation. Required when not using full_address.

street.description: Street address line (e.g., "1200 Barton Springs Rd"). Required when not using full_address.

unit.description: Unit, apartment, or suite number (e.g., "Apt 4B", "Suite 200"). Optional.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code. Optional when using structured fields, but improves validation accuracy.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves this change or credit use.

name: dealmachine_post_addresses_validate
